scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli && npm run build -w @sniptoss/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli && npm run typecheck -w @sniptoss/web && tsc -p tests/e2e && tsc -p tests/shell
scripts.e2e:shell: npm run build && pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/build-app.ps1 -Out tests/shell/.app -TestHooks && playwright test -c playwright.shell.config.ts
scripts.perf: npm run build && pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/build-app.ps1 -Out tests/shell/.app-r2r -TestHooks -Publish && playwright test -c playwright.perf.config.ts
scripts.soak: npm run build && pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/build-app.ps1 -Out tests/shell/.app -TestHooks && playwright test -c playwright.soak.config.ts
scripts.stress: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.stress.config.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && node scripts/check-design.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/check-english.mjs && npm run test:app && npm run e2e
